summary: The weekly model localizes anomalous days from the holiday list in its prompt, not from the curve. Told that no holiday falls in the week, it finds none of the 19 anomalous days, even a 20 % drop on New Year's Day. Given another week's curve under the true prompt, its answers still follow the prompt (F1 0.737) and not the curve it was given (0.053).
